# CopilotForge - Champions

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Create evidence-led Champion programmes that turn curiosity into capability and capability into contribution, with clear boundaries on what Champions do and do not do.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Champions Programme Owner
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-champions`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`capability-framework`](skills/capability-framework/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Measure | Defines the Champion capability levels - verified Chat capability, productivity capability and agent capability - each with observable evidence and an evidence rubric, and offers two routes to each level, structured learning or direct evidence submission. Use when setting what a Champion must be able to do, when Champion status needs to mean something, or when experienced colleagues want to skip training. |
| [`champion-challenges`](skills/champion-challenges/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Deliver, Scale | Designs practical Champion Challenges in which a verified Champion solves a real team problem using safe, approved tools, producing reusable assets such as prompt patterns or guides, and routing any larger opportunity to intake. Use when Champions are ready to apply their capability, when the community needs fresh practical work, or when a challenge idea needs checking for safety and scope. |
| [`champion-programme-design`](skills/champion-programme-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable | Designs an evidence-led Copilot Champions programme - purpose, charter, operating boundaries stating what Champions do and do not do, executive sponsorship, a time commitment agreed with managers, and community design. Use when starting a Champion network, when an existing network has become an unpaid help desk, or when Champion status has come to mean attendance rather than capability. |
| [`evidence-assessment`](skills/evidence-assessment/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Assure | Sets up fair, consistent assessment of Champion evidence against the capability rubric, by trained assessors who assess the evidence rather than the person, give useful feedback, handle resubmissions and appeals, and never rank anyone. Use when Champion submissions start arriving, when assessors disagree, or when someone challenges a decision about their evidence. |
| [`recognition-and-progression`](skills/recognition-and-progression/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Designs how Champions are recognised and progress - join, verify capabilities, complete a challenge, earn recognition and keep contributing - with renewal so status stays current, a regular programme health check and Champion metrics reported at programme level only. Use when designing Champion recognition, when status has gone stale, or when a sponsor asks whether the Champions programme is healthy. |
